description: This file defines the CanvasWindowController class responsible for managing a web view within a macOS application. It handles loading URLs or files, managing the browser's configuration, injecting JavaScript for message bridging, and observing file changes to reload content as needed. The class also provides UI control methods such as show, hide, and snapshot, as well as debug status updates.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller class managing a macOS window containing a WKWebView, facilitating loading content, communication bridging, and UI interactions.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement of the canvas window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: hideCanvas
methods.description: Hides the canvas window and persists panel position if applicable.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a URL or file path into the web view based on the target string.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug overlay/status indicators on the web view.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the web view.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the web view asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the web view content and saves it as a PNG image.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the file directory path associated with the session.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines whether the web view should automatically navigate based on current and last target.
